items.source: Base class for a @Configuration class to set up the Elasticsearch connection using the Elasticsearch Client. This class exposes different parts of the setup as Spring beans. Deriving classes must provide the ClientConfiguration to use. From Version 6.0 on, this class uses the new Rest5Client from Elasticsearch 9. The old implementation using the RestClient is still available under the name ElasticsearchLegacyRestClientConfiguration.
items.translation: 这是用于配置 Elasticsearch 连接的 @Configuration 类的基类，该连接使用 Elasticsearch Client 建立。此类将配置的不同部分作为 Spring Bean 暴露出来。派生类必须提供 ClientConfiguration 接口才能使用。从版本 6.0 开始，该类使用 Elasticsearch 9 中的新 Rest5Client；旧版基于 RestClient 的实现仍保留在名称 ElasticsearchLegacyRestClientConfiguration 下。

items.source: Provides the Elasticsearch transport to be used. The default implementation uses the Rest5Client bean and the JsonpMapper bean provided in this class.
items.translation: 提供要使用的 Elasticsearch 传输层。默认实现使用本类中提供的Rest5Clientbean和JsonpMapperbean。
